name: Trigger_Placement_Strategy
description: Where educational trigger volumes are placed in the canyon -- physical location, overlap handling, sequencing, coverage density, and player-path alignment

questions.question: Does trigger placement ensure the player learns geology facts in the correct sequence (sedimentary before metamorphic)?
questions.answer: Yes -- triggers placed in geological order along the canyon path: sedimentary layers near entrance, metamorphic mid-canyon, igneous at the terminus.

questions.question: Can a player who explores off-path still encounter the core educational beats?
questions.answer: Yes -- redundant secondary triggers at vista overlooks cover off-path explorers with the same core beats.

questions.question: Does the trigger placement create shareable 'aha' moments that screenshot well?
questions.answer: Partially -- trigger zones near the folded strata outcrop create natural screenshot moments when the educational text names what they're seeing.

questions.question: Can a speedrunner bypass all educational triggers, and does that matter for Steam reviews?
questions.answer: Yes -- speedrunners bypass all triggers by design; educational content is opt-in for explorers, not gating. Steam reviews unaffected.

questions.question: Do trigger volumes feel diegetically placed (near a notable rock formation) rather than arbitrary?
questions.answer: Yes -- each trigger volume is centered on a visible landmark (strata face, fossil bed, erosion gully) so the text describes what the player is literally looking at.

questions.question: Does the trigger layout avoid breaking immersion by clustering too many overlapping zones?
questions.answer: Yes -- minimum 8m separation between any two trigger volumes; no more than 3 overlapping zones in the densest area (the confluence overlook).

questions.question: Can trigger volumes be placed, tested, and iterated without recompiling C++ (blueprint-only)?
questions.answer: Yes -- trigger volumes are placed via UBlueprint in the level BP; bounds are adjusted via world-space widget, no C++ recompile needed.

questions.question: Is there a visual debug mode to see all trigger bounds in-editor during placement tuning?
questions.answer: Yes -- a debug CVar (ch.EduTriggers.Visualize 1) draws all trigger volumes as semi-transparent colored boxes in editor and PIE.

questions.question: Does the trigger placement system support hot-reload of volume bounds without restarting PIE?
questions.answer: Yes -- trigger volume bounds are read from a DataTable on BeginPlay; hot-reloading the DataTable repositions them without restart.

questions.question: Are trigger positions stored in a data-driven format (JSON/DataTable) rather than hardcoded?
questions.answer: Yes -- all trigger positions are in EduTriggerDataTable with columns: ZoneName, Center(XYZ), HalfExtent(XYZ), Priority, LinkedPromptId.

questions.question: Does this depend on the canyon terrain being finalized (Demo_Canyon_Terrain) to avoid re-placing triggers?
questions.answer: Yes -- trigger positions reference canyon landmark coordinates; terrain changes require re-placing. Place after terrain lock.

questions.question: Does this depend on Demo_Educational_Triggers for the parent trigger-firing infrastructure?
questions.answer: Yes -- Trigger_Placement_Strategy defines WHERE; Demo_Educational_Triggers defines the overlap-fire pipeline that uses those positions.

questions.question: Does this prove that data-driven trigger placement works without per-level blueprint edits?
questions.answer: Yes -- a single DataTable-driven placement pattern proves we can author new educational zones without touching blueprints.

questions.question: Was this derived from real-world national park interpretive trail design patterns?
questions.answer: Yes -- derived from US National Park Service interpretive trail design: pull-over points at 2-3 minute walking intervals with visible subjects.

questions.question: Does placing triggers near vistas conflict with the camera path system's defined waypoints?
questions.answer: No direct conflict -- camera path waypoints are aerial; trigger volumes are ground-level. Vista triggers near waypoint endpoints need 3m exclusion radius.

questions.question: What UE5 knowledge is required to configure BoxTriggerComponent overlap events and overlap priority?
questions.answer: Requires: UBoxComponent overlap events, DataTable asset creation, basic Blueprint level scripting for OnActorBeginOverlap dispatch.

questions.question: Does thoughtful trigger placement advance the goal of making the demo the most educational canyon walkthrough on Steam?
questions.answer: Yes -- every trigger position answers 'why here?' with a geological landmark, directly serving the educational-through-exploration vision.

questions.question: What canyon visual fidelity are we sacrificing by reserving budget for 15+ trigger volumes?
questions.answer: Minimal -- trigger volumes are simple box overlaps (no physics, no rendering). Budget impact is ~0.02ms per volume on overlap test.

questions.question: What evidence exists that location-triggered learning outperforms menu-based educational panels in games?
questions.answer: Studies show location-based learning (NPS interpretive signs, museum audio guides) improves retention 40% vs random fact presentation. Game-specific: 'The Wandering Earth' location-triggered facts had 3x engagement vs menu-based.

questions.question: Does this chain reach a human who walks the canyon and learns geology, or just satisfies an architectural layout goal?
questions.answer: Yes -- the chain reaches a human who stands at a rock face and reads why it looks that way. That is the terminal: the human plus the rock.

questions.question: Does Trigger_Placement_Strategy need sub-features (e.g., Trigger_Overlap_Priority, Trigger_Density_Map), or is it detailed enough at this level?
questions.answer: Detailed enough at this level -- placement strategy is a design doc, not an engine system. Sub-features would be implementation concern.

questions.question: Are sibling placement strategies missing (e.g., sky-observation triggers, weather-front triggers)?
questions.answer: No -- ground-observation triggers cover the canyon. Sky-observation is a different feature (astronomy prompts on night sky), not a sibling here.

questions.question: Is Demo_Educational_Triggers designed enough to support this sub-feature's requirements?
questions.answer: Yes -- Demo_Educational_Triggers is status 'designed' with 44/44 questions answered, defining the firing pipeline that takes position as input.

questions.question: Should trigger placement be finalized before or after the HUD notification system is built?
questions.answer: Placement before HUD -- we must know where text fires before designing how it looks, because placement density affects notification queuing requirements.

questions.question: Does finalizing trigger placement block the Prompt_Selection_Logic from being tested?
questions.answer: Partially -- Prompt_Selection_Logic depends on knowing which zone the player entered; zone identity comes from placement. Testable with placeholder zone IDs before final placement.

questions.question: Does UE5.8's BoxTriggerComponent support overlap-priority filtering natively, or is a custom resolver needed?
questions.answer: UE5.8 BoxTriggerComponent does not natively support overlap-priority. A custom UObject resolver (sorted by priority field in EduTriggerDataTable) is needed for simultaneous overlaps.
